name: 30–60-Second Cold Finish
title: End your shower with 30 to 60 seconds cold.
subtitle: Cold Exposure
rationale: A brief cold finish is the cheapest possible dose of cold exposure and requires no equipment at all.
tierTarget: A cold finish on most showers

evidence.summary: One large randomized trial of cold shower finishes found reduced self-reported sickness absence; broader outcomes remain untested.

sources.label: Voluntary cold-water exposure health effects review

indications: Mornings start slow despite adequate sleep.
Cold exposure is interesting but an ice bath is not practical.
avoidWhen: Cardiovascular disease or arrhythmia unless cleared by a physician.
